# Vector RTS (vendored)

Web Bluetooth + RTS protocol files from
[digital-dream-labs/vector-web-setup](https://github.com/digital-dream-labs/vector-web-setup),
used to pair with a real Anki Vector over BLE and send SDK requests
(including `/v1/set_eye_color`).

License: MIT. See `LICENSE` in this folder.

Minor patches applied so the files load under a modern bundler
(`Anki` / `Rts` globals).
